answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested identity-weighted rewards: each agent's earnings from the comet data market, sparrow verification swarm, and orchard compute pool lock into a stake released in small slices across fifty epochs. A flash-farm operator spawning a thousand fake sparrow identities only vests a fraction before detection, so ejected accounts forfeit most of their take. Attacker cost becomes locked capital held for the full horizon, while honest long-lived agents lose nothing and keep compounding payouts.
